amends.nature: MECHANICAL COMPLETENESS ONLY — no substantive hypothesis is changed

1_EXACT_Y_FORMULA.Y_ATR: max( max_t(HIGH_t - ENTRY_PRICE), max_t(ENTRY_PRICE - LOW_t) ) / ATR_PRIOR
1_EXACT_Y_FORMULA.t_range: entry bar THROUGH that session's own final regular bar, INCLUSIVE
1_EXACT_Y_FORMULA.ENTRY_PRICE: OPEN of bar index (r+1), where r is the claim's right-hand bar

PATH_INVARIANT.rule: ANY required entry / high / low bar unavailable -> PATH_UNAVAILABLE
PATH_INVARIANT.EARLY_CLOSE_is_not_this: EARLY_CLOSE is a VALID structural horizon and is NOT PATH_UNAVAILABLE

2_ATR_PRIOR_AUTHORITY.bar_identity: the PREVIOUS session's OWN final regular bar

authority_is_semantic_not_indexed.why: idx 25 / idx 13 are OBSERVED EXAMPLES only; a hard-coded index would become a semantic defect on a future holiday or calendar change

2_ATR_PRIOR_AUTHORITY.session_key: the session immediately preceding the claim's session for that k
2_ATR_PRIOR_AUTHORITY.availability_requirement: age >= 14 under the declared new-Massive convention
2_ATR_PRIOR_AUTHORITY.validity: ATR_PRIOR must be FINITE and > 0, else status ATR_PRIOR_UNAVAILABLE
why_previous_session_not_l_minus_1: uniform across all three position families
excludes every opening-hour bar including the claim's own
avoids M1->M2 crossing a session boundary while the other two do not
conditioning guard: some tokens are volatility/volume states, so including the claim's own bar in the normaliser would partly absorb the signal

3_STANDARDIZED_TEST_STATISTIC.frozen_once: c_j and s_j are computed ONCE from the SCALE draws and are NOT recomputed in the NULL phase
3_STANDARDIZED_TEST_STATISTIC.M_b: max over the STABLE test set of T_j^(b)
3_STANDARDIZED_TEST_STATISTIC.why_MAD_not_SD: excursion outcomes are heavy-tailed; SD would be dominated by a few extreme draws
3_STANDARDIZED_TEST_STATISTIC.why_draw_split: the draws forming the max-stat reference distribution are NOT used in the scale estimator, removing the circularity entirely
3_STANDARDIZED_TEST_STATISTIC.why_not_minP: minP would replace the frozen max-stat and would need far larger B for 1/B resolution

feasibility_measured.note: O(n) selection (partition) is required; O(n log n) sorting would make B=2000 infeasible

5_RNG.why_named: changing the CI or SMOKE draw count must NEVER shift the SCALE or NULL draws

6_SHARED_MAP: see PERMUTATION_MAP_AUTHORITY_V1 — whole session-date payload block, one pi per session_length_class per draw, shared across all securities, ALL THREE position pairs and all 20,751 claims

9_OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE_HANDLING.during_permutation: payload moves WITH its availability; participation requires the mapped payload to be AVAILABLE
9_OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE_HANDLING.undefined_draw: see PERMUTATION_STABILITY_GATE — 200/200 and 1800/1800 required, else PERMUTATION_SUPPORT_UNSTABLE with p_adj = 1 and T_j = -inf on ALL draws
9_OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE_HANDLING.no_variable_dimension_max: every M_b is a maximum over the SAME stable test set

10_CONFIDENCE_INTERVAL.role: REPORTED UNCERTAINTY — not a promotion gate, not a multiplicity correction

NO_SILENT_FALLBACK.forbidden: falling back to security-only CI because two-way is expensive
NO_SILENT_FALLBACK.if_infeasible: CI_STATUS = NOT_COMPUTED_FEASIBILITY_HOLD, and a SEPARATE amendment is required for any alternative CI methodology

UNCHANGED_FROM_PARENT: authority layers DEV / HOLDOUT / TRUE FORWARD
